defects.description: Signal-aware acknowledgement rejects during cancellation before the permit is returned.

trigger.input: timeout 20 node --input-type=module -e 'import {MessageLog,LogClient} from "./lib/message-log.js"; import {Relay} from "./src/relay.js"; const log=new MessageLog(); log.append("news",{n:1}); const r=new Relay(new LogClient(log)); const c=new AbortController(); const s=r.subscribe("desk","news",{signal:c.signal}); await s.next(); c.abort(new Error("closed")); try{await s.next();}catch{} const again=r.subscribe("desk","news");try{const v=await again.next();console.log("reconnected:"+v.value.cursor);await again.return();}catch(e){console.log(e.code ?? e.message);}'

defects.why_missed: Tests return iterators normally or cancel before iteration acquires a permit.
